faqs.question: When should my child have their first dental visit?
faqs.answer: We recommend bringing your child by their first birthday or when their first tooth appears. Early visits build trust and prevent early childhood cavities.

faqs.question: How does Dr. Rohini keep visits comfortable for anxious children?
faqs.answer: We use the proven tell-show-do technique, gentle comforting language, and sensory adjustments to ensure children feel completely safe and relaxed.

faqs.question: Are treatments available under conscious sedation?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dr. Rohini Josan Malik has specialized expertise in sedation dentistry since 2012, providing comfortable care for fearful or complex cases.

faqs.question: Why is it important to treat cavities in baby teeth?
faqs.answer: Primary teeth maintain space for adult teeth, assist speech, and allow proper nutrition. Neglected cavities can cause severe pain and damage adult roots.

faqs.question: How do I schedule an appointment with Dr. Rohini Josan Malik?
faqs.answer: You can connect directly via WhatsApp at +91 99144 46677 or visit the dental department at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mohali.

faqs.question: What safety and hygiene standards are followed?
faqs.answer: We follow hospital-grade multi-tier vacuum autoclave sterilization protocols with strict clinical sanitization between every young patient.
